title: MathModelAgent automates a full mathematical-modelling workflow
friendlyTitle: MathModelAgent helps organise mathematical modelling work
summary: MathModelAgent coordinates specialised agents to work through mathematical-modelling tasks and produce analysis, charts and a paper-style report. The repository supports multiple model providers, includes a web interface and had about 4,800 stars when reviewed.
friendlySummary: MathModelAgent uses several AI roles to analyse a modelling problem, create charts and prepare a report. It can work with different AI providers.
whyItMatters: Students and researchers can inspect it as a worked example of decomposing a technical project across specialised agents. Its generated equations, code, evidence and prose should be independently checked, and users must follow academic-integrity rules rather than submitting unreviewed output.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can show how to break a difficult modelling task into smaller steps. Check every result yourself and follow your school or university rules.
